title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy default-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The default-src directive carries the `http:` scheme token, so every resource class that has no directive of its own falls back to plaintext HTTP rather than to HTTPS only.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit default-src directive.
risk: For every directive the policy does not override, resources can be loaded over plaintext and substituted on the wire, scripts included when script-src is absent; MEDIUM because the impact depends on which directives are overridden.
